item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:45 HKT 11/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot and generally fine weather to southern China in the next few days. With the anticyclone aloft weakening during the weekend, there will be more showers over the coastal areas. A broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.
